The tenant of this property has reported the following:
Request description: "Boiler is making a loud banging noise and the radiators upstairs are cold. Hot water still works. Not urgent but it's been a week now and it's getting colder."

1) Boiler (ref TKT-CA0F52): This is a heating installation repair (your responsibility under s.11 LTA 1985), so in line with your £150 limit we have booked a Gas Safe engineer, GasSure London, to diagnose and make safe on Monday 12 October, 09:00-11:00. Their call-out is £140 inc. VAT, which is within your limit. They have been told not to do any further work or fit parts without your written approval. We will email you their findings and quote.

2) Gas safety certificate (ref TKT-333DB0): Our records show the annual gas safety certificate (CP12) for the property expired on 30 September 2026. This is a legal requirement. GasSure did last year's check for £80. We propose they do the renewal at the same Monday visit. That would bring the visit's total to about £220, which is over your £150 limit, so please reply to this email with your written OK. GasSure will confirm the CP12 price.

We will keep to email only, as you asked.

Kind regards,
Maintenance Team
